event_summary: A blue cylindrical object and a yellow ball move toward each other on a tabletop, touch, separate, and come to rest apart.
raw_event_description: The video begins with an empty light wood tabletop visible between two partially visible black cylindrical objects at the left and right edges. After a long still interval, a small blue cylinder enters from the left while a yellow ball enters from the right. They travel toward one another, make visible contact near the upper middle of the tabletop, then separate: the blue cylinder moves back toward the left side and the yellow ball moves toward the upper-right side. Near the end, both colored objects remain separated and stationary or nearly stationary.

reasons: The tabletop and two partial black edge objects are visible.
The blue cylinder and yellow ball are not yet visible in the first frame.
